title: "Compare expenditures EXIOBASE over years"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

```{r, setup, include = F}
# R version 4.2.3 (2023-03-15 ucrt)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '..', scipen = 999)

library(tidyverse)  # Version 2.0.0
library(readxl) # Version 1.4.2
```


```{r readExpenditures, include = F}
years = c(2013:2017)

# read expenditure data
df <- read.csv("data/EXIOBASE/y_NL_comparisons.csv", row.names = 1)

# Preprocess row names
rownames(df) <- gsub("[()',]", "", rownames(df))

names(df) <- as.character(years)

# the unit of expenditures in df is million US$. Now, I make the unit = €
df <- df * 1000000 * 0.9015
```


```{r readEmissions, include = F}
# read ghg emission data
ghg <- read.csv("data/EXIOBASE/emissions/EXIOBASE_footprints_comparisons.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE, colClasses = numeric())

# Preprocess row names
rownames(ghg) <- gsub("[()',]", "", rownames(ghg))
```


```{r createPlots, warning = F, echo = F}
# Create an empty list to store the plots
plot_list <- list()

# Iterate over each row of the dataframe
for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  # Create a dataframe for the current row
  row_data <- data.frame(year = years, 
                         expenditures = t(df[i, ]), 
                         emissions = t(ghg[i, ]))
  names(row_data) <- c("year", "expenditures", "emissions")
  
  # Create a line plot for the current row
  plot <- ggplot(row_data, aes(x = year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = expenditures), color = "black") +
    geom_line(aes(y = emissions), color = "darkorange3") +
    
    labs(title = row.names(df)[i], y = "Expenditures") +
    scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~., name = "Emissions")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "black"), 
          axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "darkorange3"))
    
  # Store the plot in the list
  plot_list[[length(plot_list)+1]] <- plot

}

# Print the plots
for (i in 1:length(plot_list)) {
  print(plot_list[[i]])
}
```
